fields.Institution: Ajay Kumar Garg Institute of Management
fields.Affiliation / University: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University
fields.Intake — Published:
120 MBA seats sanctioned for 2026–27 in AICTE EOA dated 16 March 2026.
Published numeric intake: 120
fields.Fees — Published: Signed 2026–27 schedule: MBA year 1 ₹1,41,943 gross including ₹5,000 refundable security. Year 2 ₹1,23,943 is published for the 2025–27 cohort. Combining them gives conditional ₹2,65,886 gross/₹2,60,886 net, not a quoted 2026–28 total. University charges extra.
fields.Fee Scope: Published year 1 actual; two-year reference uses a different cohort’s year 2 schedule. University and living charges extra. Excluded from ₹2.60886 L: university exam ₹7,500/year, digital library ₹750/year and enrolment ₹2,300 once, plus living costs. These amounts are quoted separately, not included in the conditional sum.
fields.Eligibility: Bachelor’s degree; current minimum-mark/category rules not located in an official 2026 notice
fields.Selection Process: 85% of seats through CUET-2026/UPTAC; institute process lists registration, document verification, personal interaction, admission clearance and seat confirmation. Management quota follows AKTU rules; CAT/MAT/XAT/CMAT also accepted.
fields.Application / Vacancy Signal: MBA 2026–28 admissions explicitly marked closed on current official page.
fields.Median CTC — Published:
₹5.00 LPA; graduating 2024–25, official NIRF 2026
Reported median ₹L: 5
fields.Placement — Published:
88 of 101 graduates placed in 2024–25; 87.13% of all graduates; no higher-study students reported.
Published/calculated rate %: 87.13
fields.Placement Scope: AKGIM two-year MBA 2024–25 graduates; all-graduate denominator 101
fields.Programme-Aligned Career Paths: Business/Strategy Consultant; Product/Program Manager; Operations; Sales/Brand; Finance Analyst
fields.Notes: Official final-placement page provides average, highest, placement percentage and recruiting-company count, and separately labels the ongoing 2024-26 progress figure. | Final audit: Official final-placement page provides average, highest, placement percentage and recruiting-company count, and separately labels the ongoing 2024-26 progress figure. | Final audit 18 Oct 2026: Signed fee PDFs establish year 1 ₹1,41,943 and year 2 ₹1,23,943 for different cohorts. Net conditional sum is ₹2.60886 L; university charges extra. Current EOA confirms 120 MBA seats.
